title: Ling Yuan's Oppression
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji's consciousness was about to scatter, the fragment that had been dormant in the depths of his Mental Sea suddenly burned scorching hot—something within the depths of the Tianji Record seemed to be awakening.

text.content: The Void energy suddenly froze. A withered ink-colored figure slowly materialized from the Void, surrounded by mottled specks of light, like dying fireflies. This was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul—Chen Ji's nominal guardian. A gentle smile appeared on his withered face, but that smile sent a sudden chill through Chen Ji's heart.

dialogue.content: Sect Master Ling Yuan, why bother arguing with a junior? He's merely a Servant Disciple—even if he wins, it would only soil your hands.

text.content: Yet Ling Yuan merely smiled faintly, that smile like winter ice, devoid of any warmth. He stood with hands clasped behind his back as the Nascent Soul stage's oppressive aura poured down like a tide, and the entire Martial Arena's air hummed with its pressure.

dialogue.content: A friendly exchange, nothing more—where's the dispute? Mo Xiansheng's protective devotion to his disciple is understandable. But—everyone knows that Tianqing Sect has produced a 'prodigy,' and I wish to witness firsthand what he's truly capable of.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted. He observed Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembling slightly at its edges, not from rage but from something else—restraint. Suddenly, Ling Yuan swept his sleeve, and a torrent of spiritual energy surged toward him!

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shuddered violently, attempting to intervene, but was frozen mid-air by an even more formidable force. Chen Ji then perceived a hazy silhouette materializing behind Ling Yuan—a 'Nascent Soul Dharma Form' achievable only at the mid-Nascent Soul stage!

dialogue.content: I'm merely guiding a junior, Mo Xiansheng—no need for alarm. Rest assured, I'll spare his life—after all, for a Tianqing Sect menial servant, dying in a friendly match could be considered... a fitting end.

text.content: That spiritual energy crashed down like a collapsing mountain, and Chen Ji's internal spiritual circulation immediately stalled. Gritting his teeth, he forcibly activated his bloodline resonance, and the ancient bloodline within him surged with sudden intensity. A faint golden radiance erupted from within him, clashing directly against the devastating assault.

The golden radiance collided catastrophically with the overwhelming spiritual energy, yet the outcome proved as futile as an ant attempting to topple a towering tree. Ling Yuan didn't even spare him a glance—with merely a slight tremor of that assault, Chen Ji's bloodline power dissolved instantly like ice meeting scalding water. His form spiraled backward like a severed kite, crimson staining the air in a stark arc.

An uproar erupted throughout the Martial Arena. Some gasped, others snickered, but most watched with cold indifference. Chen Ji struggled to rise, yet the excruciating pain coursing through his limbs rendered him nearly paralyzed. He sensed his Heavenly Fate depleting frantically—Tianji Record was operating autonomously, desperately seeking any chance of survival for him.

dialogue.content: This? An ancient bloodline? How laughable—I thought you were some formidable figure. Turns out you're just a good-for-nothing who relies on external objects. Without the Tianji Record Fragment, you're not even fit to carry my shoes.

text.content: Ling Yuan's voice echoed across the Martial Arena, each word striking Chen Ji's face like a slap. He leisurely walked to Chen Ji's side, gazing down at this youth he once feared with undisguised contempt in his eyes.

Gazing eyes felt like thorns on his back. Chen Ji sensed mockery, coldness, and schadenfreude in those stares—but not a shred of sympathy. He gritted his teeth,艰难地爬起身来，浑身的骨骼都在不堪重负地作响。他的膝盖几乎要再次跪倒，但他硬生生地撑住了。

Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, a faint smile on his face. That smile was appropriately warm, perfectly displaying an elder's 'concern' for a junior—and beneath it, a hidden icy killing intent. His voice was unhurried, yet it rang clearly in every listener's ears.

dialogue.content: I thought you were hiding some world-shaking secret, but turns out you're nothing special. A废物 is still just a废物.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's attack bore down like a mountain, and you felt your strength being slowly crushed. Every breath brought agony, Heavenly Fate depleting rapidly. In this hopeless crushing defeat, you choose—

choices.description: Publicly bow your head and admit defeat, preserving strength while waiting for a counterattack opportunity. You're a vindictive person—this debt will be settled eventually.
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may not give you any chance to breathe

text.content: Chen Ji slowly lowered his head, his voice hoarse and low: 'Disciple... admits defeat.' The words fell, and a chorus of mockery and laughter arose around him. Ling Yuan nodded in satisfaction, about to turn and leave.

choices.description: Even if crushed to pieces, make the opponent pay the price. Even a废物 has dignity—it's not something to be trampled upon!
choices.visible_cost: May Suffer Severe Injuries Near Death
choices.risk_hint: A casual strike from Nascent Soul stage could be fatal

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a resolute flash in his eyes. Ignoring his injuries, he mobilized his remaining strength within and growled: 'I haven't lost yet!' The golden light bloomed again, but far dimmer than before.

Ling Yuan frowned slightly, clearly not expecting this废物 to dare resist. He coldly smiled and with a wave of his hand, another even more fierce attack roared toward Chen Ji. This time, he didn't even use the Nascent Soul Dharma Form—merely the overflowing spiritual energy was enough to crush Chen Ji to pieces!

The shadow of death descended. Chen Ji felt time stretching unbearably at this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment within him vibrating frantically, seemingly responding to his despair. At this critical juncture, a flash of spiritual insight burst through his mind—a flaw in Ling Yuan's attack trajectory!

Deep within the Tianji Record Fragment, a long-sealed rune faintly illuminated. Chen Ji had no time to think—his body had already instinctively reacted. He sidestepped, and the seemingly unavoidable attack actually grazed past his shoulder, exploding a pit three feet deep in the blue stone ground behind him!
